description: Indexed min heap fails to update internal position map during sift-up swaps, corrupting subsequent decrease-key operations.
spec_notes: IndexedMinHeap._sift_up must maintain pos_map entries whenever items swap slots.

tests.test_indexed_heap.py:
from priority_queue import TaskScheduler


def test_standard_push_pop_ordering():
    sched = TaskScheduler()
    sched.schedule_task("t1", 50.0, "clean")
    sched.schedule_task("t2", 10.0, "deploy")
    sched.schedule_task("t3", 30.0, "build")
    assert sched.pop_next_task() == ("t2", "deploy")
    assert sched.pop_next_task() == ("t3", "build")
    assert sched.pop_next_task() == ("t1", "clean")


def test_decrease_key_promotes_task():
    sched = TaskScheduler()
    sched.schedule_task("t_low", 100.0, "backup")
    sched.schedule_task("t_med", 50.0, "audit")
    sched.schedule_task("t_other", 75.0, "log")
    # Boost t_low priority from 100 to 5.0 (highest priority)
    res = sched.reprioritize("t_low", 5.0)
    assert res is True
    # Must now be popped first
    assert sched.pop_next_task() == ("t_low", "backup")
    assert sched.pop_next_task() == ("t_med", "audit")


def test_multiple_consecutive_reprioritizations():
    sched = TaskScheduler()
    sched.schedule_task("a", 100, "task_a")
    sched.schedule_task("b", 200, "task_b")
    sched.schedule_task("c", 300, "task_c")
    sched.schedule_task("d", 400, "task_d")
    sched.reprioritize("c", 50)
    sched.reprioritize("d", 10)
    sched.reprioritize("b", 5)
    assert sched.pop_next_task() == ("b", "task_b")
    assert sched.pop_next_task() == ("d", "task_d")
    assert sched.pop_next_task() == ("c", "task_c")
    assert sched.pop_next_task() == ("a", "task_a")


def test_decrease_key_invalid_inputs():
    sched = TaskScheduler()
    sched.schedule_task("x", 20.0, "task_x")
    assert sched.reprioritize("x", 30.0) is False  # Cannot increase key
    assert sched.reprioritize("missing", 5.0) is False


def test_empty_scheduler():
    sched = TaskScheduler()
    assert sched.pop_next_task() is None
